attorneys.name: Katie
attorneys.bio:
The first 20 minutes of your session are complimentary. If your consultation requires additional time beyond those initial 20 minutes, you will be billed for the extra time in 6-minute increments at Katie's regular rate of $550/hr. We will send you an invoice after your consultation if any balance is owed. Thank you in advance for your prompt payment.

As a Certified Family Law Specialist and 2026 Super Lawyer, Katie focuses on a holistic and collaborative approach to marital agreements. Rather than a purely transactional process, Katie uses her background as a trained coach to help couples navigate these conversations with empathy and transparency. Learn more about Katie's experience and philosophy: https://www.bloomlegalcoach.com/katiepadilla/

attorneys.name: Riena
attorneys.bio:
The first 20 minutes of the consultation are free of charge. If you wish to continue beyond that point, extra time will be charged in 6-minute increments at Riena's rate of $475/hr. We will send you an invoice after your consultation if any balance is owed. Thank you in advance for your prompt payment.

If you decide to move forward with us after your consultation, you don't need to worry about a large upfront retainer—we work on an hourly basis, so you only pay for the time we actually spend on your matter.

Riena is a 2024-2026 Northern California Rising Star recipient who specializes in collaborative marital agreements. Whether you are seeking asset protection or a transparent, solution-oriented process, her expertise ensures you are supported with both skill and compassion. Learn more about Riena's experience and qualifications: https://www.bloomlegalcoach.com/team/riena-yu/

templates.name: Welcome / What to Expect (New Client)
templates.subject: Welcome to Bloom Family Law — Next Steps
templates.body:
Dear [Client First Name],

Thank you for choosing Bloom Family Law. We're glad to be working with you, and we want to make sure you know what to expect over the next few days.

Here's what's coming next:

1. MyCase will send you a separate email shortly, asking you to securely add a card on file. This is standard for all our clients and keeps your account ready for billing.
2. LawPay, our secure payment processor, will also email you to set up your payment account. This is a normal part of our process — please don't hesitate to complete it, as it helps us serve you without delay.
3. You'll also receive your Fee Agreement through MyCase, which you can review and sign electronically at your convenience.

If you have any questions about any of these emails, or anything else, please don't hesitate to reach out to our office.

We look forward to working with you.

[Signature]
